1: // Simple Starfield Run game
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
5: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
6: 
7: // Ship
8: const ship = {x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height-60, w:30, h:30, speed:4, health:3};
9: let keys = {};
10: addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.key]=true);
11: addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
12: 
13: // Entities
14: let asteroids = [];
15: let orbs = [];
16: let score = 0;
17: let lastAst = 0, lastOrb = 0;
18: 
19: function spawnAsteroid(){
20:   const size = 20+Math.random()*30;
21:   asteroids.push({x:Math.random()* (canvas.width-size), y:-size, w:size, h:size, v:2+Math.random()*2});
22: }
23: function spawnOrb(){
24:   const size = 15;
25:   orbs.push({x:Math.random()* (canvas.width-size), y:-size, w:size, h:size, v:1.5});
26: }
27: 
28: function rectsCollide(a,b){
29:   return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
30: }
31: 
32: function update(){
33:   // move ship
34:   if(keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
35:   if(keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
36:   if(keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
37:   if(keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
38:   ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.w, ship.x));
39:   ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height-ship.h, ship.y));
40: 
41:   // spawn
42:   const now = performance.now();
43:   if(now-lastAst>800) {spawnAsteroid(); lastAst=now;}
44:   if(now-lastOrb>1500) {spawnOrb(); lastOrb=now;}
45: 
46:   // update asteroids
47:   asteroids.forEach(a=>a.y+=a.v);
48:   asteroids = asteroids.filter(a=> a.y<canvas.height);
49:   // update orbs
50:   orbs.forEach(o=>o.y+=o.v);
51:   orbs = orbs.filter(o=> o.y<canvas.height);
52: 
53:   // collisions
54:   asteroids = asteroids.filter(a=>{
55:     if(rectsCollide(ship,a)) {ship.health--; return false;}
56:     return true;
57:   });
58:   orbs = orbs.filter(o=>{
59:     if(rectsCollide(ship,o)) {score+=10; return false;}
60:     return true;
61:   });
62: }
63: 
64: function draw(){
65:   ctx.fillStyle='black';
66:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
67:   // stars background
68:   ctx.fillStyle='white';
69:   for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
70:     const sx=Math.random()*canvas.width, sy=Math.random()*canvas.height;
71:     ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,1,1);
72:   }
73:   // ship
74:   ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
75:   ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
76:   // asteroids
77:   ctx.fillStyle='gray';
78:   asteroids.forEach(a=>ctx.fillRect(a.x,a.y,a.w,a.h));
79:   // orbs
80:   ctx.fillStyle='yellow';
81:   orbs.forEach(o=>ctx.fillRect(o.x,o.y,o.w,o.h));
82:   // UI
83:   ctx.fillStyle='white';
84:   ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
85:   ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,10,20);
86:   ctx.fillText('Health: '+ship.health,10,40);
87: }
88: 
89: function loop(){
90:   if(ship.health<=0){
91:     ctx.fillStyle='red';
92:     ctx.font='48px sans-serif';
93:     ctx.fillText('Game Over',canvas.width/2-120,canvas.height/2);
94:     return;
95:   }
96:   update();
97:   draw();
98:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
99: }
100: loop();

(End of file - total 100 lines)
